content.text:
Zero errors. Build and TypeScript both clean. Here is the summary of every change made:

**Benefits Grid (`benefits-grid.module.css`):**
- `featureCard`: Fixed `justify-content` from `space-between` (was already there) and corrected hover to `#cdebfa` (Webflow exact value)
- `fullWidthImage`: Set the exact blue-shadow filter `drop-shadow(0px 0px 30px rgba(0, 126, 188, 0.1))` matching the `blue-shadow` class from Webflow inline styles
- Added `@media (min-width: 1280px)`: `containerLarge3` stays 1280px, `paragraphSmall2` max-width 308px
- Added `@media (min-width: 1440px)`: `containerLarge3` expands to 1320px, card gets `padding-left/right: 25px`, paragraph 308px centered
- `@media (max-width: 991px)`: Grid stays **3-col** (Webflow `feature-grid.margin-top-40px` override at 991px keeps 3 cols)
- `@media (max-width: 767px)`: `worksSec` gets `padding-top:0; padding-bottom:50px`. Grid switches to **CSS flex horizontal scroll carousel** (`scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; overflow-x: auto`) with 2 cards visible — matches Slick `slidesToShow:2` at 980px breakpoint. Scrollbar hidden.
- `@media (max-width: 479px)`: `worksSec` gets `padding-bottom:35px`, cards go full-width (`flex: 0 0 100%`) matching Slick `slidesToShow:1` — eliminates the catastrophic 1883px height excess.

**How It Works (`how-it-works.module.css`):**
- `sectionRegular3BlueSec`: Corrected base padding to `70px 5% 80px` (was correct but kept)
- `fullWidthImage`: Removed drop-shadow filter — the how-it-works images use plain `.full-width-image` without `.drop-shadow` modifier
- Added `@media (min-width: 1280px)`: `featureCardBlue` gets `padding-left/right: 20px`; `fullWidthImage` gets `max-width: 100%`
- Added `@media (min-width: 1440px)`: `featureCardBlue` gets `padding-left/right: 25px`; `containerLarge3` expands to 1320px
- `@media (max-width: 991px)`: Section keeps its padding (`margin-top:0` only, NOT `padding:0` — that was the 210/186px height bug), grid stays 3-col
- `@media (max-width: 767px)`: Section gets `padding-top:0; padding-bottom:0` (base `.section-regular-3` rule), grid collapses to 1-col — fixes the 40px-shorter bug
- `@media (max-width: 479px)`: Section restores `padding: 50px 5% 60px` (Webflow `.section-regular-3.blue-sec.makeit-sec` specific override at 479px) — this is the key fix for the 548px taller mobile bug
